name: @spark-connect-js/integration-tests
description: Integration tests against a live Spark Connect server

scripts.test:integration: pnpm spark:up && node --test $(find dist -name '*.test.js') && pnpm spark:down
scripts.test:integration:coverage: pnpm spark:up && (cd ../.. && pnpm exec c8 -r lcov -o tests/integration/coverage --include='packages/spark-core/dist/**' --include='packages/spark-node/dist/**' node --test $(find tests/integration/dist -name '*.test.js')); pnpm spark:down
